records.c: object type 3, the robot gunner ($98-$A1, orange): walks a unit a frame, turning at walls, and hops up out of a wall it walks into. Every 10 frames, the first after 20, it fires a bullet (type 18, $93) 2 units a frame the way it faces and -5 to 2 lines a frame up or down at random, with the sound $81. One shot destroys it, for 100 points; touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it. A mine's blast knocks it out: it flies up and falls off the screen, for 100 points

Shot three times it explodes with 500 points. Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it

object type 5, the bonus block, level 4-2's with symbols that go straight up and down: unseen until a shot finds it, then a black block ($B0) the hero can stand on. While shots hit it, it flashes white with the sound $A0 and every fifth frame of hits throws out a bonus symbol of a random kind (the four weapons, P, G, M or L) for 500 points; after 15 symbols the next destroys it, for 5,000 points. Jumping into it from below bumps it a little hop. The symbols it throws are type 5 objects too, states 0 to 7
its first frame: state 10, 15 symbols to give ($BD34), 4 frames to the first, unseen ($FE), not hopping, the hero neither on it nor in it

object type 6, the spinning saucer ($B1-$BF): drifts a unit a frame across, turning at walls, while it bobs up and down in a 70-frame wave, about 80 lines each way. It is black and glows through brown, red, orange and yellow to white and back for 12 frames in every 34. As it spins, every third time it shows flat ($B5) it fires two bullets ($C1) left and right, and every third time it shows upright ($BD) two ($C0) up and down, with the sound $9D. Shot, it explodes for 400 points; touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it
